note: Merrick County park run by the nonprofit Platte PEER Group, three miles south of Chapman between the Platte and Wood Rivers. The Prairie campground is an open gravel loop on the prairie (sites 15-40); the 30-amp Cottonwood campground (sites 1-13) sits in the trees by the office. Coin showers (50 cents for three minutes), dump station, convenience items in the office; seven fishing ponds, a swim beach and six miles of trails. Booked online through Firefly. --Claude
summary: Bader's own pages: 36 RV + 15 tent sites; RV $39 (30 A / 50/30 A) - $44 (50 A + water) - $49 (full hookup) a night, all-inclusive incl. one vehicle pass and tax (annual pass $30-40); Firefly online booking; coin showers, dump, office store. Stored $39-49 confirmed; hookups gain water+sewer (full-hookup sites 23-34). Old note's '$20 + $6 pass' was wrong and is dropped. Max 35 ft not confirmed (Firefly asks rig length, no per-site data). Pin OK on the Prairie loop. Not waterfront stands: Wood River ~300 m north across prairie, Platte ~400 m+ SE through woods, nearest pond 0.7 acre ~140 m from Cottonwood through trees.
flags: OWNERSHIP lead (local -> private?): the park's own page says 'Bader Park is ran by the 501.3(c) nonprofit Platte PEER Group' and Firefly says 'Bader Park is not a state or national park ... we implement our own permit system'. Neither page says Merrick County owns or runs it. Under the Wabash & Erie rule a nonprofit-run park may be private; AWH's call.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands (re-audited both ways): the Prairie RV loop (sites 15-40, pin 40.98910,-98.14990) is open prairie; the Wood River (a ~10 m meandering creek) is ~300 m north across open grassland, and the Platte's braided channel is ~400 m+ south-east beyond the highway embankment and woods. The Cottonwood loop (sites 1-13, about 40.9876,-98.1490) is in trees ~140 m from a ~0.7-acre pond and ~250 m+ from the Platte. The swim-beach lake (~2.9 acres) is under the 5-acre line and is day use.
